caption: The drawing features a Victorian-era dress displayed on a headless and handless mannequin form, rendered in deep navy blue. The bodice is fitted, has long sleeves, and closes at the front with a row of buttons. There are subtle decorative elements in the form of narrow, lighter-colored bands or piping at the cuffs, shoulder seams, and waistline. The skirt is full and bell-shaped, with paneling and draped folds that are outlined in a lighter blue color, creating a sense of texture and dimension. The lower portion of a cream or light tan petticoat is visible beneath the skirt. Off to the upper right side of the composition is a secondary outline drawing of the dress, shown from the back, in grey lines without color or shading, highlighting the general shape and seam placement. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige shade, with no additional details or objects.
title: Riding Habit
